summary: Algorhythm Holdings, via wholly owned subsidiary Azure Holdings, LLC, closed the acquisition of substantially all assets of Azure Energy, LLC on September 15, 2026, under a simultaneously signed and closed Asset Purchase Agreement; Costa Rica affiliate Azure Energy, S.R.L. and the Tangen Family Trust/1979, FLP optionors are parties to limited provisions. The acquired business develops firm-capacity renewable energy infrastructure converting waste and biomass into dispatchable power, including PPAs, interconnection agreements, permits and renewable energy credits. The board received a fairness opinion from Marshall Stevens Inc. and approved the transaction. Terms, price and consideration were not disclosed in the excerpt; the 8-K also covers a new direct financial obligation, unregistered equity sales, rights modifications, officer changes and bylaw amendments. Watch for purchase-price, financing and earn-out details in the exhibits, plus dilution and integration risk.
